messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — embed-service (us-east-1) high 5xx rate. Error rate: ~12% over last 5m. Page: @alex. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embed-5xx

alex: oncall here, looking. pulled traces, spikes line up with KV eviction cycle. rolling a temporary circuit-breaker to protect downstream write path.

jamal: can you paste the command? i can help monitor dashboards.

alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin-api.internal/feature-toggle -d '{"service":"embed","circuit_breaker_qps":1}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

alex: cb toggled, errors down to ~3% in the last 60s. keeping on page for rollback window 10m :thumbsup:

maria: nice mitigation. what's customer impact (which customers + severity)?

tara: any enterprise impacted that we should loop in?

alex: three customers saw increased retries. one enterprise (Acme Co) experienced degraded ingest for ~6m, no user data lost. latency spike mostly for long sequences.

ellie: support notified Acme, they reported degraded throughput but accepted the temporary mitigation. will escalate if this hits 30m.

sam: let's lock a postmortem slot — propose tomorrow 11:00 PT (1730080000). can folks make that?

maria: +1. we'll need timeline, RCA, and action items with owners/estimates.

alex: quick live notes: root cause looks like aggressive kvcache eviction during compaction window; eviction created hot loads on origin, causing 5xx cascades.

maria: preliminary action list from live: 1) instrument eviction metrics + alerts, 2) revisit eviction policy + rate-limits, 3) persistent circuit-breaker/backpressure strategy, 4) customer comms template.

alex: ACTION: add eviction exporter metrics + alert (eviction_rate > threshold) — owner: jamal — estimate: 1d — severity: P2 — quarter: Q2

jamal: ACK. i'll open the exporter PR and add the alert rule to ops-alerts.

sam: ACTION: implement smarter cb fallback (graceful degrade + throttling tests) — owner: alex — estimate: 3d — severity: P1 (mitigates blast radius) — quarter: Q2

tara: ACTION: draft customer-facing note + support playbook — owner: ellie — estimate: 1d — severity: P2

maria: ACTION: add RCA writeup + link to incident timeline in tracker — owner: sam — estimate: 0.5d — severity: P3

maria: prioritize P1 into next sprint (blocker for availability), carry P2 items into remediation backlog for Q2 planning, flag P3 for documentation.

alex: i'll attach logs, flame graphs, and the exact eviction window timestamps to the incident file when i finish notes.

incident-bot: Incident record created: https://incidents.redwood/1730004444 — status: mitigated (monitoring)

sam: thanks all. please add the estimates to the ticket, link PRs, and mark items done when merged. we'll cover prioritization in Monday planning if anything shifts. :rocket:
